title: ACS Sauces, Seasonings, Spices
agency_path: City of New York > Citywide Administrative Services
description_text:
All bids are submitted electronically using NYC PASSPort. To review the details (bid documents, pre-bid conference notices, etc.) of this solicitation and participate, you must have a PASSPort account. Please visit the PASSPort Public RFx Site (aka 'Procurement Navigator') at: https://passport.cityofnewyork.us/page.aspx/en/rfp/request_browse_public and use the 'keyword' search field to locate the solicitation for 'ACS Sauces, Seasonings, Spices'. You may also search using the EPIN 85727B0024. If you have any issues with PASSPort, please contact the PASSPort Helpdesk at: nyc.gov/mocshelp

Bid opening and Pre-Bid Conferences will be held virtually via Microsoft TEAMS, please see links to register in PASSPort.
